expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit is expected to shift the executing pointcloud scalar in a defensible direction.
expected_response.primary_observable: final predicted target affinity (unavailable to design roles)

failure_modes: A pair-kernel or moment diagnostic is treated as an operative force the executing pointcloud scalar does not contain.
Occupancy and softmin signs at one landmark are collapsed into a single shared quality axis.
Recorded joint-head survival credit is read as decoded terminal affinity benefit.
Turnover residual is read as a causal selection effect rather than an accounting diagnostic.
A non-monotone, sign-unstable observed-node trend is used to justify a direction rule.
A temporal derivative is interpreted as a spatial coordinate gradient.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are on short-range pair-distance shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 negative; endpoint_effects:9-13, branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can be connected to that observable without treating a diagnostic feature as an independent force the formula does not contain. Landmark occupancy/softmin signs are opposite at the same landmark and occupancy is a non-monotone shell density, so they do not define a shared quality axis (endpoint_effects:14-16, 32, 34). Joint internal RMS carries the reproducible negative contrast while translation is weaker (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153/228/230/305/307), but no permitted edit targets internal RMS separately. Within-selector diagnostics show selection innovation negatively associated with observed child score gain (joint_diagnostics:2), so raising alignment is not a free improvement. Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support terminal metadata at 0.99/1.0 outside the observed window), and turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics including score reclassification (turnover:1/2/14/17/47/134/227/497). Observed-node trends are non-monotone and sign-unstable with polynomial fits rejected and extrapolation disallowed (continuous:0/1/70/71; curve_support legendre_runtime_allowed false), and the information audit states its excess-distance metric is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian (information_audit). With the affinity-first objective and no defensible expected advantage from any registered bounded edit, retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported choice; temperatures remain fixed and no temperature edit is proposed.
